overview.about: The HSBC Women's World Championship is one of the LPGA Tour's marquee events in Asia, played at Sentosa Golf Club in Singapore. Billed as 'Asia's Major', it draws one of the strongest fields outside the majors to a tropical, resort-island setting. The 2027 tournament is on 26 February - 1 March.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 HSBC Women's World Championship runs 26 February - 1 March at Sentosa Golf Club, Singapore. The limited, no-cut field of the world's leading players makes it one of the LPGA's most prestigious regular-season stops.
